rules.null_means: No defensible public project value was identified in Step 2.
rules.scenario_assumption_means: A pre-results screening range, not a Terafab fact.
rules.unknown_gate_rule: An indispensable unknown that cannot be bounded by an admitted scenario makes the affected result indeterminate.
rules.target_guard: P_TARGET_RATED_OUTPUT is manufacturing output and must not be used as facility electrical load.

parameters.name: annual rated output embodied in good compute devices
parameters.applicability: Primary interpretation of an ambiguous public phrase; alternatives remain mandatory.

parameters.name: meaning assigned to the public 1 TW/year phrase
parameters.applicability: The project source does not resolve the semantics; conclusions must be conditional on this interpretation.

parameters.name: filed first operations or incentive years
parameters.applicability: Applicant schedule, not proof of realization; Phase 4 has an internal filing conflict retained in the schedule snapshot.

parameters.name: final ERCOT point and capacity of interconnection
parameters.applicability: Texas location alone does not demonstrate an executable ERCOT interconnection.

parameters.name: publicly disclosed project wafer capacity
parameters.applicability: No public phase capacity was identified; model output may not be presented as a filed capacity.

parameters.name: publicly disclosed facility electric load
parameters.applicability: No public phase load was identified. The 1 TW/year output claim is prohibited as a substitute.

parameters.name: publicly disclosed project water withdrawal
parameters.applicability: Water-treatment claims do not establish water availability or permitted withdrawal.

parameters.name: screening wafer diameter
parameters.applicability: Industry-scale advanced-fab screening convention, not a disclosed Terafab process specification.

parameters.name: gross compute die area
parameters.applicability: Broad pre-results geometry envelope; upper bound is one maximum exposure field, not a Terafab die disclosure.

parameters.name: rated power represented by one good compute module
parameters.applicability: Public accelerator analogs only; AI5, AI6, and D3 specifications are not public.

parameters.name: effective good-output yield through die, package, and test
parameters.applicability: Deliberately broad epistemic range; no public Terafab yield was identified.

parameters.name: logic dies per compute module
parameters.applicability: Architecture envelope only; packaging mix is undisclosed.

parameters.name: facility electricity per wafer start
parameters.applicability: Broad range around a derived TSMC shipment comparator; wafer starts, process complexity, and company boundaries differ.

parameters.name: annual facility electric load factor
parameters.applicability: Continuity-of-operation envelope for peak conversion, not a disclosed Terafab operating profile.

parameters.name: cooling coefficient of performance
parameters.applicability: Cooling electricity is derived from thermal load and COP; it is not independently sampled.

parameters.name: gross water withdrawal per wafer
parameters.applicability: Review and corporate comparator envelope; mask-layer and recycling definitions must be reported.

parameters.name: ultrapure water use per wafer
parameters.applicability: Screening range containing the review comparator; no site process recipe is implied.

parameters.name: process water recycling fraction
parameters.applicability: The 0.881 comparator is company-reported process-water recycling, not necessarily withdrawal reduction.

parameters.name: ERCOT loss-of-load expectation limit
parameters.applicability: Must be evaluated together with duration and magnitude criteria.

parameters.name: maximum expected loss-of-load event duration
parameters.applicability: One-percent exceedance condition applies.

parameters.name: 2026 expected highest hourly average load-shed magnitude limit
parameters.applicability: Annual update required; it must not be propagated unchanged through 2050.

parameters.name: generic central-station technology lead times
parameters.applicability: Generic construction assumptions only; site, permitting, interconnection, transmission, fuel, water, and commissioning adders are mandatory.
